phase: source-learning operation exploration; not final method evaluation
method: Pair unchanged Fixed with a real per-image report from the existing native report generator. This expands source-learning action evidence after generic expert observations and an HCL candidate failed. No learned policy or evaluation claim.
probe: One existing chest_xray_report_generator call per eligible image with its standard configuration. No generated question or answer options are passed to the report tool. Fallible report bound to image/event. No eligible images means exactly no probe context. All calls count toward8 total.
shared_interface_revision: Reuse previous paired-run shared interface and guards. If no image is eligible, both arms receive the identical Fixed context (no empty observation wrapper). Other parser and scoring rules unchanged.
feedback: Only 13 source-aligned visual-discriminator cases receive benchmark agreement feedback. Etiology/management details remain unadjudicated. All other reference outcomes are withheld and cannot be semantic learning rewards. All46 can contribute execution/cost/error evidence.
controls: Same input order, model, original Fixed context, tool guards and case budgets. Alternating arm order by immutable index. Extra probe action/token cost separately reported, not cost-matched. No replacement or rerun based on outcomes.
selection_and_evaluation: No method-development or frozen-evaluation input/target is read by this experiment. No automatic candidate generation or promotion from results. Complete all92 attempts and analyze useful evidence vs format/wrapper differences.
budget: 4h hard deadline shared by retries; stop at10GB apparent run bytes; strict per-server actual<50GB. Shared existing assets read-only; run-local caches and private outputs.
stop: Stop on privacy or visual-contract invariant breach; preserve failures and budgets. No post-result parser relaxation or outcome-dependent repeat.
measurement: Missing episodes count against full aggregate denominator, but paired gain/loss require both recorded arms; failed recorded arms count incorrect. Unknown reference groups always have null semantic feedback. Per-case 900s alarm includes forced probes; requests use model generation max_time; independent supervisor bounds total run.
motivation: Prior expert source feedback gave no demonstrated useful-evidence gain; HCL source memory candidate tied repeated development and was rejected. Test whether a different existing observation type provides discriminating information for future evidence-conditioned operation selection; not baseline optimization.
reference_scope: Same frozen46 source groups/13 qualified visual-feedback groups/33unknown and exact approved images as previous acquisition; repeated source data, not additional independent samples.
